summary: A 1970 survey description gives the Clinton tower as 110 feet tall; Wikipedia lists it as torn down, visible on imagery until 2019.

facts.design: Grey square metal cab with a conical roof, windows on all four sides, on four steel channel legs
facts.status_note: Wikipedia lists the tower as torn down; no removal date is given.

Visible on satellite imagery up until 2019, per Wikipedia
